read_commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'pyproject.toml' -g 'setup.cfg' -g 'tox.ini' -g '.github/workflows/*' -g 'api.rst' -g 'exceptions.rst' -g 'test_commands.py' -g 'test_custom_classes.py' -g 'core.py' -g '__init__.py' -g 'parser.py' -g 'testing.py' -g 'CHANGES.rst' -g 'README*'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'for p in /AGENTS.md /var/AGENTS.md /evaluation-path /evaluation-path /evaluation-path /evaluation-path /evaluation-path/AGENTS.md; do if test -f "$p"; then cat "$p"; fi; done; rg --files --hidden -g '"'AGENTS.md' -g '"'! .git'"' -g '"'!**/SKILL.md'"'; nl -ba pyproject.toml; nl -ba tox.ini; nl -ba src/click/__init__.py; nl -ba docs/api.rst"

/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba tests/test_custom_classes.py; nl -ba tests/test_commands.py | sed -n '110,210p'; nl -ba src/click/parser.py | sed -n '230,290p'; nl -ba docs/exceptions.rst; git log -12 --oneline; git show --stat 70c673d"

/bin/zsh -lc "git log -12 --oneline; git show --format=fuller --stat HEAD; git show --format=fuller --stat 70c673d; git show 70c673d -- src/click/core.py tests/test_basic.py; nl -ba docs/exceptions.rst | sed -n '1,110p'; nl -ba src/click/parser.py | sed -n '250,280p'; nl -ba tests/test_commands.py | sed -n '148,195p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'invoke|forward|standalone_mode|call_on_close|with_resource|result_callback|close|default_map|eager|help_option' tests/test_context.py tests/test_commands.py tests/test_basic.py tests/test_command_chaining.py tests/test_custom_classes.py; rg --files .github/workflows; git log -8 --format='%h %s' -- src/click/core.py; nl -ba CHANGES.rst | sed -n '1,85p'; nl -ba .github/workflows/tests.yaml"

/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '115,150p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '440,500p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '555,620p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '725,790p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '1280,1345p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '1420,1455p'; nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '1650,1795p'; nl -ba src/click/testing.py | sed -n '450,505p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/click/core.py | sed -n '705,723p'; nl -ba src/click/testing.py | sed -n '385,414p'; nl -ba tests/test_commands.py | sed -n '1,67p'; nl -ba tests/test_commands.py | sed -n '235,253p'; nl -ba tests/test_commands.py | sed -n '530,546p'; nl -ba tests/test_context.py | sed -n '305,322p'; nl -ba tests/test_basic.py | sed -n '30,56p'; rg --files tests | rg 'chain|typing'; git show --format=short 26aa7bf -- src/click/core.py | head -85; git status --short"
